1.keywords: processing can take up to 30 minutes, most cost-effective
1.trap: Lambda max timeout is 15 minutes — can't process a 30-minute job
1.rule: Job > 15 min → EC2 ASG scaled on SQS queue depth (not Lambda); SQS over Amazon MQ unless JMS/AMQP needed

6.keywords: pre-signed URL works from laptop, fails from EC2 Spot portal
6.trap: Enabling versioning does not invalidate pre-signed URLs
6.rule: Pre-signed URL failures → expired URL or the signer's credentials (EC2 should use an IAM role, not ~/.aws/credentials)

7.keywords: only authorized IAM users or roles, inspect each request end-to-end, service maps
7.trap: CORS is a browser rule, not authentication; CloudWatch Logs don't give end-to-end traces
7.rule: API Gateway + IAM principals → AWS_IAM authorization (SigV4); latency + service map → X-Ray

8.keywords: single point of failure, dual-tunnel VPN between CGW and VGW
8.trap: A VPC can attach only one VGW — a 'second VGW' is impossible
8.rule: VPN HA: VGW is already redundant (2 tunnels); add a second CGW in another data center

10.keywords: multiple domains, no re-provisioning when a new domain is added
10.trap: A wildcard cert covers sub-domains of one domain, not different domains
10.rule: Many domains on one ALB → multiple certs on one listener (SNI); or CloudFront with dedicated-IP custom SSL

13.keywords: use its own encryption key, periodically rotated, fully managed, Redshift Spectrum
13.trap: SSE-S3 keys are AWS-managed, not the company's; File Gateway adds overhead
13.rule: Own key + rotation on S3 → SSE-KMS; in-transit → bucket policy with aws:SecureTransport

14.keywords: 🔁 tape library, MAM, catalog of faces, metadata for videos
14.trap: 🔁 Third miss on this pattern. SageMaker notebooks don't do recognition; Rekognition does
14.rule: Tape archive + video face/object tagging → File Gateway to S3 + Rekognition (face collection) + Lambda → MAM

16.keywords: RTO 30 min, RPO 5 min, cost-effective, stateless web/app tiers
16.trap: 🔁 Hot standby is not cost-effective when RTO is 30 min — restoring EC2 snapshots fits
16.rule: Match the DR tier to the RTO: 30 min → backup/restore for stateless tiers + cross-Region read replica for the DB

17.keywords: restrict to only the web portal's EC2 instances, not traverse the public Internet
17.trap: NACLs can't reference the gateway prefix list for this; the bucket policy must also check identity
17.rule: S3 via gateway endpoint: endpoint policy (which bucket) + bucket policy (aws:sourceVpce + IAM role) + IAM role on EC2

19.keywords: dashboard only accepts email via SMTP, automate
19.trap: SQS can't send email; something must poll it
19.rule: Notify by email → SNS (email subscription); offload batch reads → RDS read replica

20.keywords: run once, 48 hours, without sacrificing data integrity
20.trap: Reserved Instances need a 1–3 year term — wrong for a one-off job
20.rule: One-off EMR: On-Demand master + core (hold data), Spot only for task nodes

23.keywords: custom domain, end-to-end HTTPS from browser to origin
23.trap: The CloudFront default certificate only works for *.cloudfront.net, not a custom domain
23.rule: Custom domain on CloudFront → ACM cert on CloudFront (us-east-1) + HTTPS to the origin with a matching cert

24.keywords: write spikes, erratic behavior, cost-effective, strict RPO
24.trap: DynamoDB with high WCU + EMR cluster = much more cost and overhead than a queue
24.rule: Write bursts to a slow backend → SQS buffer + consumer that flushes to the DB

26.keywords: MQTT broker overloaded, sensor data lost, recommended
26.trap: Scaling your own broker (ASG + NLB + EFS) is DIY and costly
26.rule: IoT devices over MQTT → AWS IoT Core endpoint + IoT rule straight to DynamoDB

28.keywords: use the company HSMs to generate the key material
28.trap: CloudHSM key store uses AWS CloudHSM, not the company's own on-prem HSMs
28.rule: Key material from your own HSM → KMS key with Origin=EXTERNAL + import key material (BYOK)

29.keywords: run only once, 8 hours, most cost-effective
29.trap: Same trap as Q20 in this test — Reserved for a one-off 8-hour job
29.rule: One-off EMR: On-Demand master/core + Spot task nodes; never Reserved for short jobs

30.keywords: quickly and cost-effectively, reduce latency, database on-premises
30.trap: Migrating the DB to Aurora is slow and may not even be compatible — not 'quick'
30.rule: 'Quick + cheap + reduce read latency' → add ElastiCache in front of the DB

32.keywords: near-real-time, durable parallel storage, deliver to a data warehouse
32.trap: S3 first + SQS is batch-ish and needs custom code — not near-real-time
32.rule: Near-real-time ingest + analytics → Kinesis Data Streams + consumers; results → Redshift

37.keywords: only private files, no public read/write, MINIMAL effort
37.trap: An SCP works but is far more effort (and SCPs don't target one bucket)
37.rule: Stop public S3 objects with minimal effort → S3 Block Public Access

42.keywords: in a few weeks, quickly improve, unpredictable bursts
42.trap: Full migration to AWS (VM Import + RDS) takes too long for a few weeks
42.rule: Short deadline + traffic bursts on on-prem site → CloudFront with a custom origin to offload

45.trap: VPC Flow Logs capture metadata (L3/L4), never packet payloads
45.rule: Need packet contents → VPC Traffic Mirroring on the ENIs to a monitoring appliance

48.keywords: CVE assessment, new AMIs, rescan every 30 days
48.trap: AWS Config can't scan the OS for CVEs and the requirement is every 30 days, not continuous
48.rule: CVE scans → Amazon Inspector; periodic re-checks → EventBridge schedule → SSM Automation

50.keywords: default CloudFront domain name, HTTPS between viewers and CloudFront
50.trap: A cert on the ELB covers CloudFront→origin, not viewer→CloudFront; self-signed is never for public sites
50.rule: *.cloudfront.net + viewer HTTPS → Viewer Protocol Policy (redirect/HTTPS only) + default CloudFront cert

53.keywords: no downtime, maintain full capacity during deployment, stop subsequent deployments on failure
53.trap: All-at-once takes instances out of service — reduces capacity
53.rule: Full capacity during deploy → Elastic Beanstalk Immutable (or blue/green); never All at once / Rolling

55.keywords: least-privilege, security group per tier, Aurora port 3306
55.trap: A NACL with the public subnet CIDR opens access to every instance in that subnet
55.rule: App → DB access: SG-to-SG references (EC2 SG outbound to DB SG; DB SG inbound from EC2 SG)

57.keywords: 🔁 mobile app, social IdPs, store to S3 and DynamoDB directly
57.trap: 🔁 The option uses long-term access keys — apps must use temporary STS credentials
57.rule: Mobile/web app + social login → web identity federation (AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity / Cognito) with temporary credentials

58.keywords: strict RPO/RTO, highly available, fault-tolerant, single city
58.trap: DynamoDB + an A record (not alias) to the ELB — an ELB has no fixed IP
58.rule: HA web tier → ASG across 3 AZs + ALB + Aurora Replicas; Route 53 Alias record to the ELB

60.keywords: 🔁 should not be stalled, deployed first before analysis, LEAST impact on development
60.trap: 🔁 IAM restriction blocks developers before launch — the stem asks to detect after deployment
60.rule: 'Don't block developers' → detect and remediate after launch (Config rule / scheduled Lambda + terminate + SNS)

61.keywords: latest OS patches, accessible at any time, LEAST administrative overhead
61.trap: CloudShell is a browser CLI, not a server host; AppStream as bastion adds complexity
61.rule: Keep a Windows server patched with low overhead → EC2 + Systems Manager Patch Manager

63.keywords: desktop client applications, MINIMAL change, most cost-effective
63.trap: WorkSpaces = full virtual desktops per user (expensive); self-hosted MySQL on EC2 adds ops
63.rule: Stream desktop apps → AppStream 2.0 (WorkSpaces applications); DB → Aurora; tiers → ASG + ALB

71.keywords: create/configure resources, view Organizations info, least privilege
71.trap: AdministratorAccess includes IAM and full Organizations control — far beyond least privilege
71.rule: Developers who need everything except IAM/user management → PowerUserAccess (also allows organizations:Describe*)

72.keywords: filesystem reached capacity, solve and prevent it from happening again
72.trap: Creating a new FSx + copying profiles is manual — FSx can grow in place
72.rule: FSx for Windows: increase storage in place (update-file-system); automate with CloudWatch alarm → EventBridge → Lambda

75.keywords: SCP allows only cloudtrail:* and iam:*, IAM policy allows s3:*
75.trap: The IAM policy's NotAction Deny doesn't affect S3; the SCP allow list is the blocker
75.rule: SCPs never grant: an allow-list SCP must include every action; missing s3:* blocks CreateBucket even if IAM allows it

2.keywords: Oracle RAC One Node, automated backup
2.rule: Oracle RAC → EC2 + EBS + Data Lifecycle Manager snapshots

3.watch: Contrast Q14 (missed) — tape gateway is for backup, not processing
3.rule: Keep tape backup workflow → Tape Gateway → S3/Glacier

4.rule: Discover on-prem servers for TCO → Application Discovery Service

5.keywords: VM needs on-prem dependencies, private connection
5.rule: Direct Connect requirements → BGP + MD5-capable router + DX link

9.keywords: encrypt at rest + in transit, customer-provided keys
9.watch: Watch SSE-C headers vs SSE-KMS headers

11.keywords: scanned forms, OCR, reduce human effort
11.rule: Forms OCR → Textract + Comprehend, orchestrated by Step Functions

12.watch: EFS is not HPC scratch storage
12.rule: HPC → cluster placement group + EFA + FSx for Lustre

15.keywords: DB on EC2, second Region, failover
15.watch: Contrast Q16 — here the DB must go cross-Region
15.rule: Cross-Region DR DB → Aurora Global Database + Route 53 failover

18.keywords: reduce DDoS attack surface, blast radius
18.watch: Shield Standard alone vs Advanced + WAF
18.rule: DDoS: CloudFront + SG/NACL minimal ports + WAF rate rules + Shield Advanced

21.keywords: bursty writes, no change to data model
21.watch: Same idea as Q24 (missed) — SQS buffers writes
21.rule: Spiky writes to RDS → SQS + Lambda consumer

22.keywords: growing input files, availability, processing time
22.watch: Don't pick bigger instances; scale out on queue length
22.rule: Batch file processing → S3 for I/O + SQS + ASG on queue depth

25.rule: Steady state → Reserved; peaks → Auto Scaling

27.keywords: DynamoDB throttled writes, data not lost, MOST cost-effective
27.watch: Raising WCU works but costs more
27.rule: Throttled writes → SQS in front of DynamoDB

31.keywords: Lambda traffic in two increments, trace downstream calls
31.rule: Two-step Lambda shift → Canary; tracing → X-Ray active tracing

33.keywords: Windows CMS, HA, shared storage, least overhead
33.rule: Windows shared storage → FSx for Windows + ASG across 3 AZs

34.keywords: all accounts, durable + secure audit logs
34.rule: Organization trail + one bucket with MFA Delete + encryption

35.watch: Never create IAM users with access keys for outsiders
35.rule: Auditor → read-only cross-account role in each account trusting the auditor

36.keywords: 200 TB shared FS, 72-hour runs, largest cost reduction
36.watch: Not keeping the always-on EC2 file cluster
36.rule: Data in S3 Intelligent-Tiering + lazy-loaded FSx for Lustre per run

38.rule: Multi-Region active-active NoSQL → DynamoDB global tables + Fargate per Region

39.keywords: NAT instance, long-running DB update fails on timeout
39.watch: NAT gateway sends RST, NAT instance sends FIN
39.rule: NAT instance timeout → FIN; replace with NAT gateway

40.keywords: page load < 3 s, global audience, MOST cost-effective
40.watch: Same idea as Q30 (missed) — ElastiCache cuts DB latency
40.rule: Slow pages → ElastiCache for sessions/queries + CloudFront for reusable content

41.rule: L7 attacks → AWS WAF rules + Shield Advanced

43.rule: Active-active Regions → latency routing + Evaluate Target Health

44.keywords: 5 GB file, millions of global downloads
44.rule: Large global downloads → S3 + CloudFront + Route 53

46.keywords: new AMI per release via UpdateStack, replace instances
46.rule: ASG instance replacement in CloudFormation → UpdatePolicy AutoScalingRollingUpdate

47.keywords: employees only, from corporate network or home, not exposed
47.watch: Not public subnet + IP allow list
47.rule: Remote employee access → SSL VPN in public subnet + app in private subnet

51.keywords: stored volume, make data available on AWS if on-prem fails
51.rule: Storage Gateway volume → EBS snapshot → restore to EBS on EC2

52.keywords: EC2 app generates pre-signed URLs, access S3 securely
52.watch: Contrast Q6/Q17 — credentials on EC2 come from the instance role
52.rule: EC2 → S3: IAM role, temporary credentials from instance metadata

54.rule: Elastic Beanstalk blue/green → deploy to staging env + swap CNAMEs

56.rule: Test stage + CloudFormation change sets + CodeDeploy blue/green

59.keywords: cost visibility, enforce tags on future DynamoDB/RDS
59.watch: Contrast Q75 — here the SCP denies untagged creates
59.rule: Tag Editor + cost allocation tags + SCP deny create without tags

62.keywords: query strings in different order/case, cache hit ratio
62.watch: Not more TTL or more origins
62.rule: Normalize query strings with Lambda@Edge on viewer request

64.keywords: classified data in S3, PII, automated
64.rule: Find PII in S3 → Macie; who accessed it → CloudTrail data events

65.keywords: Redshift + KMS encryption, DR in another Region
65.rule: Encrypted Redshift cross-Region → snapshot copy grant in destination Region

66.keywords: OS vulnerability, record patch compliance changes
66.rule: Patch Manager for patches + AWS Config for compliance history

67.keywords: verify results on new DynamoDB entries, minimal changes
67.watch: Not polling with a scheduled job
67.rule: React to new DynamoDB items → DynamoDB Streams → Lambda

68.keywords: existing accounts into Organizations, full admin control, LEAST effort
68.watch: Invited accounts don't get OrganizationAccountAccessRole automatically
68.rule: Invite accounts + create OrganizationAccountAccessRole in each

69.rule: Centralize findings → Security Hub with a delegated administrator account

70.keywords: enforce tags on resource creation across accounts
70.rule: Tag on creation → Service Catalog TagOptions/auto-tags + CloudFormation resource tags

73.keywords: third-party vendor, discover EC2, confused deputy
73.rule: Third party → cross-account role with ExternalId condition

74.keywords: on-prem LDAP, same corporate account, not SAML
74.rule: LDAP (no SAML) → custom identity broker → STS AssumeRole

inconsistent: SQS as a write buffer in front of a slow/throttled DB
ElastiCache to cut DB load and latency
Systems Manager Patch Manager for OS patching
Storage Gateway type: tape backup → Tape Gateway; process the content → File Gateway
EC2 → S3 access via IAM role (temporary credentials)
Federation/third party → STS temporary credentials, never long-term keys
Cross-Region DR sized to the RTO
